author: Tosaki
name_in_asr: 玉門関 (玄奘傳: 瓜州北五十餘里, 瓠蘆河上)
asr_identification: Tang Yumen pass of 629 on the 窟窿河 (Kulong river) 50+ li N of the then Guazhou city (= Suoyang cheng 鎖陽城), near Shuangta-bao 雙塔堡, Anxi (now Guazhou) county, Gansu; later moved with the prefectural seat
evidence: Philological: sets the Life (50+ li N of Guazhou, on the Hulu river) against Yuanhe zhi 40 (玉門關 20 bu E of Jinchang county) and P.2005, P.2691 and the Tongdian distances between Shazhou, Changle and Jinchang (280/300/319 li; Tang li taken as 0.56 km). Of four views (see :2) he supports (3): two successive passes, Xuanzang's at Shuangta-bao and a later one beside the moved seat; the decisive point is identifying the Hulu river, which he takes to be the 窟窿河 (argued in his 1997 article in 彦根論叢 306), not the 苦水 (Li Zhengyu) or the Shule. No fieldwork.
quote: 地として四ヶ所が考えられる。この中では（3）…説を支持したい。それには『玄…河の存在が決め手になる。その河の比定には窟二…今日の窟山河＝萌藍河である可能性が高い
note: Japanese review of the debate before 2000. OCR layer of the Shiga repository scan is garbled and runs the two columns together (窟山河 = 窟窿河, 萌藍河 = 瓠蘆河, 双三墾 = 雙塔堡); the reading here is from the clearer passages. Supports the 雙塔堡 area for Xuanzang's pass, like Li Bingcheng; differs from Li Zhengyu (馬圈 small city, Hulu = 苦水) and Wang Nai'ang (六工 city).

author: Tosaki
asr_identification: four locations: (1) 雙塔堡; (2) NW of Anxi county town; (3) 雙塔堡, later moved to beside 鎖陽城; (4) S foot of 常樂山 on the 苦水 (Li Zhengyu 1997)
evidence: Classifies the earlier views with their authors: (1) 陶保廉『辛卯侍行記』, 林競; (2) 欽定皇輿西域圖志, Stein; (3) 向達「兩關雜考」, 嚴耕望『唐代交通圖考』 (1985, p.436); (4) 李正宇『敦煌歷史地理導論』 (1997, pp.173–179), with Jinchang county at 踏實鄉 破城子 and the pass east of it.
quote: （3）玉門関＝双三墾→鎖三二…（4）玉門関＝常楽山南麓・二水のほとり…李二二『二二、歴史地理三論』（新三豊出版公司
note: Useful map of the debate as it stood in 2000 (garbled OCR; 双三墾→鎖三二 = 雙塔堡→鎖陽城, 李二二 = 李正宇). Background for 01.04.x3; no new evidence.

author: Tosaki
asr_identification: Suoyang cheng 鎖陽城 (also 苦峪城), Guazhou county, Gansu, for the Guazhou of 629; the prefectural seat (晉昌縣城) later moved
evidence: From bearing and distance (Xuanzang's pass 50+ li N; Shidao's 瓜州 → 沙州 SW 300+ li) and from the discrepancies between Tongdian, Yuanhe zhi, P.2005 and P.2691 in the Shazhou–Guazhou and Guazhou–Suzhou distances (39–46 li), he concludes the seat moved, and that the Guazhou of the Life is Suoyang cheng.
quote: 沙州治の位置は方位・距離の点から鎖陽城（一名は苦硲城）と考えるのが適当…以上によって若州城＝晋下県城が移動したのは…のいう瓜州城は今の鎖陽城
note: Agrees with the common identification of Xuanzang's Guazhou with Suoyang cheng (01.04.x1), on textual grounds only (OCR: 沙州治 here = 瓜州治, 若州城＝晋下県城 = 瓜州城＝晉昌縣城).

author: Tosaki
name_in_asr: 第一烽 (玄奘傳; 行狀 「關西百餘里有一烽」)
asr_identification: the 新井驛 (Xinjing post) of P.2005, 27 li 200 bu N of Changle 常樂 county town
evidence: P.2005 (沙州圖經) lists 新井驛・廣顯驛・烏山驛 as kept by Guazhou, 227 li 200 bu NE of Shazhou, while Changle lies 200 li from Shazhou; so 新井驛 stood 27 li 200 bu N of Changle. The Life puts the first beacon 80+ li beyond a river 10+ li from the pass, i.e. c.100 li from the pass, as the Xingzhuang also says (關西百餘里有一烽). He identifies the first beacon with 新井驛 and infers the pass lay 80–90 li from Changle.
quote: つまり玉門関から第一峰までは100里く…河。離三十鯨里」にも符合する。この第一峰は常…楽県城の北にあった新井駅である。『沙州圖経』…駅である新井駅は玉城の北27里200歩にあった。
note: An early proposal (2000) of the 新井驛 = first beacon equation, later developed by Li Zhengyu 2006 (all five beacons = the five posts of P.2005; see wanglei2020_yumen_eastward:2). Note the posts were set up under Gaozong/Wu Zetian, after 629, so the equation assumes post and beacon shared the site. OCR: 峰 = 烽.

author: Tosaki
asr_identification: the 'Fifth Road' 第五道 from 新井驛 in Guazhou north via 第五驛 to 柔遠縣 of Yizhou (Hami)
evidence: In a table of the Tang roads west from Sha- and Guazhou (from P.2005, Yuanhe zhi), he lists the 第五道 (Moheyan road) as starting at 新井驛 and running north through 第五驛 to Rouyuan county of Yizhou, distinct from the 矟竿道 from Shazhou to Yiwu county. In part 1 (2000, p.62) he says Xuanzang took this road.
quote: （5）瓜州新井駅から北へ，第五駅〜伊州柔遠県
note: Route frame for 01.04.x4–x9: Xuanzang's road = the later 第五道/莫賀延磧道 entering Yizhou at Rouyuan. No new evidence for any single place.

author: China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan (State Parties)
asr_identification: Suoyang City 鎖陽城, 62 km SE of Guazhou county seat, Jiuquan, Gansu, presumably the seat of Tang Guazhou
evidence: Nomination dossier: inner city c.285,000 m² with partition wall, barbicans, mamian and turrets; outer city, yangmacheng, two fortresses; c.90 km of trunk and branch canals irrigating c.60 km²; 2,106 tombs in a 5 × 16 km field; Ta'er temple. Initial survey and excavation date the site to the 7th–13th c.
quote: The site of Suoyang city is located 62km southeast of…excavations indicate that the site of Suoyang City dates…back to the 7th to the 13th century , presumably the site…of ancient Guazhou Prefecture during the Tang Dynasty.
note: Agrees with the usual identification of Xuanzang's Guazhou; the dossier says 'presumably' and rests the Tang date on survey, not on an inscription naming Guazhou. Excerpt of 6 pages (pdf 1, 297, 298, 454, 471, 474) of the 5,714-page dossier.

author: China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan (State Parties)
name_in_asr: Suoyang City; Guazhou City of Tang Dynasty
asr_identification: Suoyang City = Tang Guazhou city (works cited)
evidence: Footnote 86 gives the basis: Zhao Jianlong's 2012 survey of the city and the Ta'er temple (Gansu Institute) dating the city's floruit to Tang and Western Xia (7th–13th c.); earlier identifications with Tang Guazhou by Yan Wenru (Wenwu 1953.12), Li Bingcheng (敦煌學輯刊 1990.3), Wang Beichen (瓜州歷史地理研究, 2006), Li Hongwei & Xie Yanming (隴右文博 2008).
quote: Other research findings estimate Suoyang City might have been the former site of Guazhou City of Tang Dynasty
note: Bibliography for 01.04.x1; the cited Chinese works are listed as wanted in lit_batch20_biblio.tsv.

author: China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan (State Parties)
evidence: The management plan for the site repeats from the Life that Xuanzang passed Guazhou and lectured there for over a month; no argument.

author: Li Weili 李伟丽
asr_identification: prefers Wang Nai'ang's 常樂古城 = 六工古城 (Liugong city), Guazhou county; reports the 雙塔堡 and 馬圈村 views
evidence: Review in 中国社会科学报 2065 of the Han and Tang Yumen debates. Tang pass: (a) 雙塔堡 — 陶保廉 (37 km W of Bulongji, NE of Shuangta-bao, W of the mouth of the 土胡卢河 into the Shule), 閻文儒, 李并成 (2001, 2005, 2008); (b) 馬圈村 small city — 李正宇 1997; (c) 常樂古城 = 六工古城 — 王乃昂 2020 (中国边疆史地研究 2020.1), using texts, excavated documents, dating, finds and remote sensing; the pass and the 墨離軍 both at 常樂, start of the Northern Wei Yiwu road; the finds at Liugong match Jin–Tang 宜禾/晉昌/常樂 county.
quote: 陶保廉在《辛卯侍行记》卷5“十一月初九日”中推测，唐玉门关在布隆吉堡西37公里，双塔堡东北，土胡卢河与疏勒河回河口西侧…认为唐玉门关和墨离军驻地应在河西走廊西段的常乐古城，即今瓜州县“六工古城”遗址…对于新玉门关址，笔者倾向于王乃昂的观点
note: Three-way disagreement on 01.04.x3. This is the only accessible summary of Wang Nai'ang 2020 (wanted). Note that the Life puts the pass on the river 50+ li N of Guazhou, which a pass at Changle (W of Suoyang) has to accommodate.

author: Li Weili 李伟丽
asr_identification: an old river channel E of the small city at 馬圈村 (15 km NW of 桥子乡, Anxi), = the 苦水 of P.2005 (Li Zhengyu 1997)
evidence: Li Zhengyu found two ruined cities W of 馬圈村 in 1996: a small one on the W bank of an old channel and a large one c.30 m (= 20 bu) SW of it; the small one, 20 bu NE of the large, is the Tang pass (with an inner enclosure for the office), the large one Jinchang county. He traced the old channel and equated it with the Hulu river and with the 苦水 of P.2005. His objections to 雙塔堡: no city ruins or sherd scatter, no contemporary cemetery, and it does not fit the Gua–Yi post road.
quote: 1996年，李正宇在今安西县桥子乡西北15公里马圈村西发现了两座大小不同的古城遗址…城东古河道，即玄奘所说“上置玉门关”的“瓠庐河”、岑参诗注中的“胡卢河”。通过考察，这条古河道得以复原，且与敦煌遗书P.2005《沙洲都督府图经卷第三》所载之“苦水”相合…他认为双塔堡处既无古州县城址及瓦砾陶片散布，附近又没有汉唐州县城必有的同时代墓葬群；从唐代瓜伊驿道经行路线进行评量，玉门关亦不合置在双塔堡
note: Second-hand report of Li Zhengyu 1997 (wanted). For 01.04.x2 it gives the main alternative to the Shule: a lost channel (苦水) near 馬圈村, not the Shule itself.

author: Li Weili 李伟丽
evidence: Li Bingcheng: the pass moved c.210 km east from Xiaofangpan after AD 74 and stood near Shuangta-bao until the end of Tang; restated in 新玉门关位置再考 (敦煌研究 2008.4).
quote: 李并成的《新玉门关位置再考》（《敦煌研究》2008年第4期）再次强调，新玉门关位于今瓜州县双塔堡一带是征而可信的
note: Second-hand; Li Bingcheng's articles are wanted.

author: Wang Lei 王蕾
asr_identification: Xuanzang's Guazhou = Suoyang cheng; Guazhou seat moved after 727 to the large city at 馬圈村, with the new Yumen at the small city there (Li Zhengyu 2010, accepted)
evidence: Reports Li Zhengyu (双塔堡绝非唐玉门关, 敦煌研究 2010.4, pp.74–79): from Jiu Tangshu (Tibetan sack of Guazhou), Dunhuang documents and Wujing zongyao, Guazhou city was destroyed and Zhang Shougui built a new one; Jinchang county stood at Suoyang cheng before 727 and at the large 馬圈 city after, the pass at the small 馬圈 city; he used P.2005 post bearings and distances, satellite images and field survey of nearby ruins and fields. Wang finds the 馬圈 cities fit Suishu (馳至玉門關晉昌城) and Yuanhe zhi (關在縣東二十步), and puts Xuanzang's Guazhou at Suoyang.
page: sohu reprint of 西域研究 2020.2, text at nn. 82–84
quote: 认为唐代瓜州城曾被吐蕃毁坏，张守珪又于别处修筑新城，所以郡治晋昌县有两处，开元十五年（727）前位于锁阳城遗址，之后位于马圈村大古城，而新玉门关位于马圈村小古城…从玄奘出行的时间，其逃避凉州官府的阻挠昼伏夜行所至的瓜州，应位于锁阳城…马圈村的大小古城方位正好符合《隋书》《元和郡县图志》中“驰至玉门关晋昌城”、“玉门关，在县东二十步”的记载
note: Agrees on Suoyang for 01.04.x1; for 01.04.x3 the 馬圈 small city is a post-727 location in Li's scheme, so where the pass stood in 629 remains open even on his view. Text taken from a 2022 web reprint (博物馆世界 on sohu.com), not the journal PDF.

author: Wang Lei 王蕾
asr_identification: the five posts of P.2005: 新井驛, 廣顯驛, 烏山驛, 雙泉驛, 第五驛 (Li Zhengyu 2006)
evidence: Footnote reporting Li Zhengyu, 玄奘瓜州、伊吾经行考 (敦煌研究 2006.6, pp.82–91): the five beacons are the five posts set up under Gaozong and Wu Zetian; P.2005 (沙州都督府圖經 卷三) lists 新井、廣顯、烏山、雙泉、第五、冷泉、胡桐 between Gua and Yi (cf. 李正宇《古本敦煌乡土志八种笺证》, 2008, p.50). The road is the 第五道/莫賀延磧道.
quote: 李正宇在《玄奘瓜州、伊吾经行考》一文论证这五烽，即高宗武后时期设置的新井驿、广显驿、乌山驿、双泉驿、第五驿
note: By this equation the first beacon = 新井驛 and the fourth = 雙泉驛; the modern sites Li assigns (popular accounts say 第四烽 = 大泉) are not given here — Li 2006 is wanted. Second-hand.

author: Wang Lei 王蕾
asr_identification: the pass moved east to the Guazhou area with the Northern Zhou Yiwu road; Sui guan officials at Changle; on the road from Guazhou to Yizhou and Xizhou
evidence: Argues against an Eastern Han move: the pass stayed W of Dunhuang to Northern Wei and moved east under Northern Zhou with the rise of the 伊吾路 (Zhoushu, Pei Ju); Suishu notes a 關官 at Changle county. A Turfan travel-pass file (Astana 509, 733) bears three seal impressions 玉門關之印, and travellers from Yizhou or Shazhou to Guazhou had to pass it. She reports Zheng Bingling & Cao Hong 2010 (pass on the Shule near Shuangta) and Li Bingcheng 2001/2008 (Shuangta-bao) beside Li Zhengyu.
page: sohu reprint, abstract, text at n. 89, n. 82
quote: 随着北周伊吾道的开通，玉门关东迁至今瓜州地区，隋代又在此设置关官…特别值得注意的是，在唐益谦申请过所文书所提交的一份残文书上，钤有三枚“玉门关之印”…同年郑炳林、曹红在《唐玄奘西行路线与瓜州伊吾道有关问题考察》一文通过对瓜州自然地理条件，认为唐玉门关位于瓜州双塔附近的疏勒河上
note: Dates the pass Xuanzang met (Sui/Tang, on the Yiwu road) without fixing its site; documents the 玉門關 seal as evidence the pass functioned on the Gua–Yi/Xi road.

author: Seng Haixia 僧海霞
asr_identification: near Shuangta-bao 雙塔堡 on the Shule river, c.30 km N of Suoyang cheng and c.50 km E of the Guazhou county seat (following Li Bingcheng 2001)
evidence: Cites the Life's account and Li Bingcheng 2001; gives the distances 30 km N of Suoyang and 50 km E of the county town.
quote: 玉门关位于锁阳城北约 30 km，即今瓜州县城东 50…km 处的疏勒河岸双塔堡附近
note: Measured-style distances for the 雙塔堡 view: 30 km ≈ 54 Tang li (at 0.56 km/li) from Suoyang, consistent with the Life's 50+ li to the river. Second-hand; Li Bingcheng 2001 wanted.

author: Zhang Yan 张燕 (Xinhua), reporting Li Bingcheng
asr_identification: near Shuangta-bao 雙塔堡, Anxi (now Guazhou) county, Gansu (Li Bingcheng)
evidence: News report (16 Nov 2002) of Li Bingcheng's field visits and criteria: the pass should lie on the S bank of the Shule; among hills with beacons; with a beacon line to the NW; on the line of the Han wall (昆侖塞); not far from Sui–Tang Jinchang city. No ruin of the pass has been found; it may be eroded or reused in the Qing fort of Shuangta-bao. Earlier: 陶保廉 (W of Shuangta-bao, E of the 兔葫芦河), 夏鼐 and 向達 in the 1940s.
quote: 列出判定唐代玉门关地理位置的多项具体条件：应位于今疏勒河南岸；应置于遍设烽燧的山间；西北处应有沿线烽燧；应在汉长城“昆仑塞”址上；应距隋唐晋昌城不远等，并据此确认，唐代“玉门关”的地理位置就在甘肃省安西县双塔堡附近…目前，考古工作者还没有找到唐“玉门关”遗址
note: States the 雙塔堡 view's criteria and admits no site evidence; the headline 'experts confirm' overstates it.

author: Wang Jianjun 王建军
asr_identification: Suoyang cheng, 22 km E of Suoyang-cheng town, Guazhou county = Tang 晉昌縣 and seat of Guazhou from 621; Ta'er temple 1 km E of the city
evidence: Report of the Dunhuang Academy / CASS / Guazhou excavation of the Ta'er temple 2019–2023 (1,800 m²): gate platform, main hall platform 25.5 × 16.5 m, great stupa (base 10 m, extant 9.8 m) and nine small stupas, 11 monks' rooms, kiln, pits; finds include glazed tiles, mural and sculpture fragments, tsha-tsha, Kaiyuan tongbao and Jiayou yuanbao coins. City: inner city 28.5 ha (walls 457–576 m); 2,000+ tombs (Eastern Han, Wei-Jin, Tang). The chronology of the temple buildings is left for later study.
quote: 唐武德四年(621 年)改为晋昌县，设瓜州府于此…塔尔寺遗址西距锁阳城城址 1 千米…根据目前工作完成情况来看，锁阳城遗址区塔尔寺遗址的分布范围和建筑形制基本明晰，仍需后期对发掘出土材料整理研究，以便了解建筑的时代延续等问题
note: Restates Suoyang = Tang Guazhou (01.04.x1) as settled history; the excavation gives a Tang coin but no inscription naming the place. Does not mention Xuanzang or the identification of Ta'er temple with the 阿育王寺/大雲寺 where Hui Yi'an, Cao & Zheng 2010 put his month's stay (wanted).
